description: This file defines the Aws\Sts\StsClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Security Token Service (STS). It includes methods for various STS operations such as assumeRole, getSessionToken, and getFederationToken. The class manages regional endpoint configurations and creates credentials from STS results.

classes.name: StsClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Security Token Service (STS), supporting regional endpoint configuration and credential creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the STS client with regional endpoint options and other configurations.

methods.name: createCredentials
methods.description: Creates AWS credentials from STS API results, parsing ARNs for account IDs and handling expiration.

methods.name: addBuiltIns
methods.description: Adds service-specific built-in values regarding regional endpoints to the client.
